rules.reason: Headache after a head injury needs same-day assessment.
New confusion with headache needs same-day assessment.
Severe headache with vomiting needs same-day assessment.
Headache with fever should be reviewed by a doctor.
A severe headache should be reviewed by a doctor.
A new headache at age 50 or over should be reviewed by a doctor.
A headache lasting a week or more should be reviewed.
A moderate headache lasting three days or more.

source_notes: Rules are student-authored from the general principles in public triage guidance (NHS emergency advice, ESI handbook, WHO emergency triage). Source clause references still to be added; NOT clinically validated.
